reviewSamples.author: Daniela Benitez
reviewSamples.text: I eat at Leña Churrascaría more than 3-4 times a week, both for lunch and dinner after work, and I can honestly say I've never been disappointed. Over the past several months, I've tried many different items on the menu, and everything is...

reviewSamples.author: Brandi P
reviewSamples.text: More than I expected! Great fresh food. This was $21 and I had leftovers. Greek kale salad 10/10, bacon wrapped fillets and fresh mashed potatoes... I will definitely be back!

reviewSamples.author: Javier Anaya
reviewSamples.text: Very good food. Well served and the quality its always great no matter what time or day you go its delicious.

reviewSamples.author: Jeruel Mendez
reviewSamples.text: The most interesting cheese sandwich ever, its a new experience. Totally unexpected! It gave me that wow factor. But the bite was unbelievable! Will definitely visit again! 5star

reviewSamples.author: John Nazario
reviewSamples.text: We had the pork loin and the Picanha. With salad, tostones and fries. The meats were good. The sides (tostones, fries and salad were also good)
